run_gen_gtest_pred_impl: run gen_gtest_pred_impl.py with a max arity argument to generate Google Test predicate assertion headers and unit tests
generate_header: generate the gtest_pred_impl.h header file with predicate assertion macros up to the specified arity
generate_unittest: generate the gtest_pred_impl_unittest.cc unit test file with tests for predicate assertions up to the specified arity
implementation_for_arity: generate C++ template implementation code for n-ary predicate assertion helper functions and macros
tests_for_arity: generate C++ unit test code with 64 test combinations for n-ary predicate assertions using functions and functors
